gaps.sentence: I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: The car broke ___ on the motorway.
Who will take ___ from the current director?
gaps.explanation: take over = take control of a job/company.

gaps.sentence: You should cut down ___ sugar if you want to lose weight.
gaps.explanation: cut down ON something = reduce it; cut out = eliminate completely.

gaps.sentence: The band broke ___ in the middle of the song.
Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: Wake ___ — you'll be late for school!
I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.
